summary_1line: Bhima slays the Rakshasa Maniman and many Yakshas; Yudhishthira rebukes him for needless violence while the survivors report to Kuvera, who sets out in anger.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima leaps into the air and hurls his mace like a thunderbolt, smashing the Rakshasa Maniman to the ground.
The Pandavas reach the mountain summit and see Bhima standing amid the fallen bodies of huge Rakshasas, mace in hand like Indra after battle.
Kuvera, eyes red with anger, mounts a dark cloud‑colored chariot while a thousand golden Yakshas arm themselves to follow him.
